<h2 class="wp-block-heading"><strong>Grain Policy</strong></h2>



<p class="wp-block-paragraph">All grain delivered to the Albert Lea Elevator shall be considered stored at the time of delivery unless arrangements have been made prior to or at the time of delivery.</p>
